blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — The state weather bureau has warned residents of southern Bukidnon of moderate to heavy rains, particularly in the afternoon and evening. Speaking to the Inquirer on Saturday, October 17, Catherine Asunto, weather specialist at the Mindanao Regional Services Division of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration, said the intertropical convergence zone (ITCZ) remains the prevailing weather system bringing moderate to heavy rains across Mindanao. “This convergence of wind patterns from the northern and southern hemispheres is not static; its movement depends on broader atmospheric conditions,” Asunto said.
